children: FuelCell Energy Inc. reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue of $33M, a net loss of ($45.27M) and diluted loss per share of ($0.64), reflecting lower product and generation sales versus the year-ago period and continued investment in commercial scale-up initiatives.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted loss per share attributable to common stockholders”.
Revenue mix shifted as product and generation revenues declined year-over-year while Advanced Technologies revenue remained steady, indicating greater weighting toward services and R&D contracts.

Executed a major commercial agreement: a potential $2.6B Clean Energy Purchase Agreement (CEPA) with Fit for up to 380MW across four phases; Phase 0 (30MW) is funded with initial deliveries expected in Q4 FY2026.
Manufacturing scale-up progressed at the Torrington facility with annualized production of ~37.1MW in Q3 and targets of 100MW by October 2026 and 500MW by June 2028.
Operational fleet and projects totaled 62.8MW; a Groton outage led to a $42.6M impairment and the site is being upgraded to three 2.5MW blocks with completion expected in FY2027.
Service backlog momentum: committed backlog rose to $1.30B, and awarded capacity backlog from Fit phases 1–3 adds an estimated $1.1–1.3B of potential product and service demand.
